compress_TRAJECTORY: compress a single agent trajectory to fit within a target token budget by summarizing middle turns
compress_TRAJECTORY_async: compress a single agent trajectory asynchronously using async API calls for summarization
process_directory_TRAJECTORY: process all JSONL files in a directory to compress trajectories within a target token budget
compress_TRAJECTORY_CLI: compress agent trajectories from a JSONL file or directory to fit within a target token budget
compress_TRAJECTORY_CLI_sample: compress a sampled percentage of agent trajectories from a JSONL file or directory
